remaining: Source errors preserved deliberately and documented in transcription.notes: (1) solution 1 г) prints 'където тялото окончателно спирай .' instead of 'спира'; (2) alternative solution 1 г) gives the acceleration as 'a ≈ 0,028 m/s' with a wrong unit (should be m/s^2); (3) problem 3 Б is announced as 5 т. in the statement but the point breakdown printed in the official solution sums to only 4 т. (0,5+0,5+0,25+0,25+1+1+0,5).

Structural choice (not a defect, noted in transcription.notes): problem 3 is printed as two sections А and Б; it is represented as a single problem with parts labelled 'А. а)', 'А. б)' and 'Б.'. Likewise the clarifying paragraph 'Приемете, че силата на тягата F ...' is printed AFTER part в) of problem 2 and was folded into the problem statement as a second paragraph.
paper.round was taken from the archive path ('III Национален кръг'); the printed cover page itself does not name the round, only 'НАЦИОНАЛНА ОЛИМПИАДА ПО ФИЗИКА, 29 – 31 март 2024 г.'
